notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Serrated Biskelion.
Serrated Biskelion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Serrated Biskelion by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Serrated Biskelion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
